name: How long does a typical TBI lawsuit take to resolve?
description: TBI lawsuits vary, from a few months to several years, depending on injury severity, liability, and negotiation.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical TBI lawsuit take to resolve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a TBI lawsuit can vary significantly depending on several factors, including the severity of the injury, the complexity of medical evidence, the clarity of liability, and the willingness of the parties to negotiate. Some cases may settle relatively quickly, within a few months, if liability is clear and damages are easily quantifiable. More complex cases involving extensive medical treatment, long-term care needs, or disputed liability can take several years to resolve, especially if they proceed to trial. Your lawyer can provide a more specific timeline after reviewing the details of your case.
